description: This file defines a 'LoginPage' class representing the login page in a web automation testing framework using Selenium WebDriver. It contains methods to open the login page, perform login actions, and check for specific UI elements indicating invalid credentials or missing input.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Represents the login page with methods to interact with login elements and verify their states.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Navigates the web driver to the login page URL.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Performs login action by inputting username and password and clicking the login button.

methods.name: IsInvalidCredsShown
methods.description: Checks if the 'Invalid credentials' alert is visible on the page.

methods.name: IsRequiredShown
methods.description: Checks if the 'Required' message is visible on the page.
